redact: permanently remove (black out and delete) content from a PDF; use the legal-document term, not 'hide'
Bates numbering: sequential page identifiers used in legal discovery; keep 'Bates' and use the local legal term for numbering
merge: combine several PDFs into one file
split: divide one PDF into several files
flatten: turn form fields and annotations into fixed page content
OCR: make scanned text searchable; keep the abbreviation 'OCR' and explain once if the English does
metadata: hidden document properties such as author and creation date
on your device: processed locally in the visitor's own browser; never imply any upload or server
never uploaded: files are not sent anywhere; keep this absolute and exact
watermark: text or image stamped across pages
Practice: the name of a paid plan; keep as 'Practice'
Pro: the name of a paid plan; keep as 'Pro'
Business: the name of a paid plan; keep as 'Business'
